# Airwindows: the suites

<!-- Generated by tools/airwindows_catalogue.py; edit that, not this. -->

From airwin2rack b6eef0af60. Each suite is one CLAP plug-in (ADR-0171, ADR-0173); its Algorithm parameter chooses what plays, in the order below (the parameter's value is the row's index, from 0). The console systems are not here: they are the mixer's native group summing (ADR-0174). *Auto gain* marks the algorithms whose default is on; a suite's own switch starts on where most of its algorithms' is.

## Not a plug-in: the mixer's group summing (17)

Compiled into the engine (ADR-0174); EveryConsole is compiled in neither, because it cannot select a system at this commit.

- AtmosphereBuss: AtmosphereBuss is Console5 processing with powerful new acoustic distance effects.
- AtmosphereChannel: AtmosphereChannel is Console5 processing with powerful new acoustic distance effects.
- C5RawBuss: C5RawBuss is the original Console5 algorithm, with optional very gentle DC suppression.
- C5RawChannel: C5RawChannel is the original Console5 algorithm, with optional very gentle DC suppression.
- Console9Buss: Console9Buss is just the summing from ConsoleX.
- Console9Channel: Console9Channel is just the summing from ConsoleX.
- ConsoleLABuss: ConsoleLABuss is the Airwindows take on the Quad Eight console.
- ConsoleLAChannel: ConsoleLAChannel is the Airwindows take on the Quad Eight console.
- ConsoleMCBuss: ConsoleMCBuss is the initial, bright take on the MCI console.
- ConsoleMCChannel: ConsoleMCChannel is the initial, bright take on the MCI console.
- ConsoleMDBuss: ConsoleMDBuss goes for the tone shaping of the classic MCI console!
- ConsoleMDChannel: ConsoleMDChannel goes for the tone shaping of the classic MCI console!
- EveryConsole: EveryConsole is mix-and-match Airwindows Console.
- PDBuss: PDBuss is Console5 and PurestDrive, sittin’ in a tree… (i.e. both at once, on channels and buss)
- PDChannel: PDChannel is Console5 and PurestDrive, sittin’ in a tree… (i.e. both at once, on channels and buss)
- PurestConsole3Buss: PurestConsole3Buss is an alternate algorithm for minimalist Console.
- PurestConsole3Channel: PurestConsole3Channel is an alternate algorithm for minimalist Console.
